IC1: History of prostate [OR], bladder [OR], or rectal cancer
IC2: History of transurethral resection of the prostate (TURP) [OR], open prostate surgery [OR], or radiofrequency [OR] or microwave therapies
IC3: History of open bladder, rectosigmoid colon, or other pelvic surgery
IC4: Patient is unwilling to discontinue alpha blockers 1 month after study treatment
IC5: Patient is unwilling to discontinue 5-alph reductase inhibitors 1 month after study treatment
IC6: Neurogenic bladder [OR] or other neurologic disorder impacting bladder function such as Parkinson's disease [OR], multiple sclerosis [OR], cerebral vascular accident [OR] or diabetes
IC7: Any other confounding bladder [OR] or urethral pathology, including urethral stricture [OR], bladder neck contracture [OR], or bladder atonia
IC8: Active prostatitis [OR] or urinary tract infection
IC11: Inability to discontinue oral anticoagulant 2-5 days prior to study treatment
IC12: Coagulation disturbances [NOT] not normalized [AND] by medical treatment
IC13: Iodinated contrast [AND] allergy that, in the opinion of the Investigator, cannot be adequately premedicated
IC15: Known severe peripheral vascular disease [OR] or major iliac arterial occlusive disease
IC17: Clinically significant cardiac arrhythmia [OR] or other cardiac disease [OR] (including congestive heart failure), uncontrolled diabetes mellitus [OR], clinically significant respiratory disease [OR], or known immunosuppression
IC18: Other condition that the Investigator believes puts the patient at risk for a complication during the procedure
